skill.name: deployment-procedures
skill.description: Guides safe production releases with platform selection, pre-deployment checks, verification windows, rollback planning, and operational decision points.
skill.summary: Plan safer production deployments with checks, rollback strategy, and verification steps.
skill.author: sickn33

content.value_statement: Production releases fail when teams skip verification and rollback planning. This skill guides platform selection, deployment checks, monitoring, and rollback decisions.
actual_capabilities: Explains platform choices for static sites, web apps, microservices, serverless, Docker, and Kubernetes.
Provides pre-deployment checks for code quality, builds, environment variables, backups, monitoring, and team communication.
Outlines prepare, backup, deploy, verify, and rollback phases for production releases.
Compares rollback methods across managed platforms, VPS, Docker, and Kubernetes.
Covers verification windows, health checks, logs, key flows, and performance monitoring.
Highlights release anti-patterns and safer operational practices.
limitations: It teaches principles and checklists, not ready-to-run deployment scripts.
It does not replace platform documentation, staging validation, or production change approval.
It does not inspect live infrastructure, logs, credentials, or deployment configuration.
It cannot guarantee zero downtime without environment-specific testing and monitoring.

use_cases.title: Solo Developer Release Planning
use_cases.description: A solo developer can turn a release idea into a checklist with verification, backup, and rollback steps.

use_cases.title: DevOps Deployment Review
use_cases.description: A DevOps engineer can review release plans for missing safety checks, monitoring gaps, and rollback triggers.

use_cases.title: Engineering Manager Readiness
use_cases.description: An engineering manager can align teams on release timing, communication, ownership, and incident response expectations.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a platform-specific deployment checklist for a [type] application on [platform]. Include preparation, backup, deployment, verification, and rollback steps.

prompt_templates.title: Select a Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare rolling, blue-green, and canary deployment for [change]. Recommend one strategy and explain rollback and monitoring needs.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Release Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this deployment plan for [service]. Identify missing safety checks, unclear rollback triggers, and verification gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Emergency Rollback
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an emergency rollback workflow for [service]. Include assessment order, decision points, communication steps, verification, and post-incident review.

output_examples.input: A team needs to deploy a Docker web service.
output: Recommended path: prepare the image and confirm environment variables.
Deploy with monitoring open, then verify health, logs, key flows, and performance.
Keep the previous image ready for rollback.

output_examples.input: A release includes a risky database migration.
output: Use a staged plan with backup verification and clear rollback triggers.
Watch error rates and key transactions during the first verification window.

output_examples.input: A service outage starts after deployment.
output: Rollback if restart does not restore service quickly.
Investigate root cause after stability returns.

best_practices: Adapt the checklist to the platform, service risk, and available rollback mechanism.
Define objective rollback triggers before the deployment starts.
Monitor health checks, logs, key user flows, and performance during the verification window.
anti_patterns: Deploying without a tested rollback path or current backup.
Copying deployment commands without understanding platform-specific effects.
Treating a green build as complete production verification.

faq.question: Does this skill run deployment commands?
faq.answer: No. It provides decision guidance and checklists for safer releases.

faq.question: Can it choose a hosting platform?
faq.answer: It helps compare platform patterns, but final selection depends on traffic, team skill, cost, and compliance needs.

faq.question: Does it cover rollback planning?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains rollback triggers, platform-specific rollback methods, and post-incident review.

faq.question: Is it suitable for Kubernetes?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes Kubernetes as a deployment and rollback context, but it does not replace cluster-specific procedures.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, or Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Does it replace production approvals?
faq.answer: No. Teams still need approvals, staging tests, monitoring access, and environment-specific validation.
